free_tier.stated: no free tier is published; one fixed-term price for a whole 8x RTX PRO 6000 server, from USD 1.70 per GPU per hour, USD 13.60 an hour for the whole server and about USD 9,930 a month, excluding VAT. No hourly or on-demand instance; none of H100, A100, L40S, RTX 4090 or L4 is offered.
free_tier.notes: the hourly figure is an equivalent for comparison; monthly figures use 730 hours

per_object_cap.notes: the whole server: eight GPUs, two AMD EPYC 9754 CPUs and 1.5 TB of memory

retention.notes: a machine record: drives are purged at the end of a term

egress.terms: a dedicated 1 Gbps uplink with no traffic charges

interface_detail: the page says root access, SSH keys and BMC remote console are provided; not probed
tooling: root on the bare-metal host over SSH plus a BMC console, virtual media and power control; any OS from your own ISO
chaining: A fixed-term whole-server rental, quoted rather than self-serve, with a 99.5% monthly availability SLA; the hourly equivalent is only a comparison with hourly offers.
limits_note: No quota is stated; the constraint is the fixed monthly term and the quote-based onboarding of about 5 business days.
binding_note: No quota is stated; the constraint is the fixed monthly term and the quote-based onboarding of about 5 business days.

identity_cost.detail: No self-service sign-up: a quote is requested by contact form, phone or WhatsApp, then a Master Services Agreement is signed electronically with company details, and the first month is paid in advance by bank transfer. Whether a private individual is accepted is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: The aggregator profile states a single data centre near Sofia, Bulgaria, and a first node in production since July 2026.
